questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Microwave Transmission Lines, Characteristic Impedance, Reflection Coefficient & VSWR
questions.text: Derive the Transmission Line Equations for voltage $V(z)$ and current $I(z)$ in terms of propagation constant $\gamma = \alpha + j\beta$ and characteristic impedance $Z_0 = \sqrt{\frac{R + j\omega L}{G + j\omega C}}$. Define Voltage Standing Wave Ratio ($VSWR = \frac{1 + |\Gamma|}{1 - |\Gamma|}$) and Reflection Coefficient $\Gamma = \frac{Z_L - Z_0}{Z_L + Z_0}$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Smith Chart Applications
questions.text: Explain Double-Stub Impedance Matching on a transmission line using a Smith Chart. Explain why double-stub matching is preferred over single-stub matching in tunable RF circuits.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Microwave Network Analysis & S-Parameters
questions.text: Define Scattering Parameters (S-Parameters) for an $N$-port microwave junction ($b = S a$). State and prove the properties of S-matrix: (a) Symmetry for reciprocal network ($[S]^T = [S]$), and (b) Unitary property for lossless junction ($[S] [S]^T = [I]$). Why are H-parameters and Z-parameters difficult to measure at microwave frequencies?

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Active Microwave Devices
questions.text: Explain the Gunn Effect and Ridley-Watkins-Hilsum (RWH) Transferred-Electron Mechanism in GaAs diode. Draw the velocity-field ($v-E$) characteristic showing negative differential resistance region and explain Gunn domain formation.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Active Microwave Devices
questions.text: Explain Avalanche Transit-Time devices: IMPATT (Impact Ionization Avalanche Transit-Time) Diode and TRAPATT Diode. Explain Read diode structure ($p^+-n-i-n^+$), phase delay mechanism between RF voltage and avalanche current ($90^\circ + 90^\circ = 180^\circ$), and output power/efficiency.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Passive Microwave Components
questions.text: Explain Two-Cavity Klystron Amplifier: Velocity Modulation process, Applegate diagram, bunching parameter ($ heta$), drift space, and cavity interaction. Derive the expression for RF current and electronic efficiency.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Smith Chart Applications
questions.text: Explain Reflex Klystron Oscillator: Repeller voltage ($V_r$), velocity modulation, round-trip electron bunching transit time ($T = (n + 3/4)T_0$), mode curves, and electronic tuning range.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Passive Microwave Components
questions.text: Explain Cylindrical Cavity Magnetron (Crossed-field tube): Hull Cut-off Magnetic Field ($B_c = \sqrt{\frac{8 m V_0}{e b^2 (1 - a^2/b^2)^2}}$), Hartree Resonant Anode Voltage, $\pi$-mode oscillations, and strapping to avoid mode jumping.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Smith Chart Applications
questions.text: Explain Traveling Wave Tube (TWT) Amplifier: Slow-Wave Structure (Helical waveguide), wave-electron beam synchronization ($v_e \approx v_p$), amplification mechanism, and comparison with Klystrons.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Smith Chart Applications
questions.text: Explain Quarter-Wave Transformer ($Z_{in} = \frac{Z_0^2}{Z_L}$) for matching a real load $R_L$ to transmission line $Z_0$. Explain Multi-section binomial and Chebyshev impedance matching transformers.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Passive Microwave Components
